page.notes: The first line of the second paragraph is set in a larger, roman-looking section number "30." and is kept as a paragraph, not a heading. The word "supervaca-neum" is broken at the line end with its printed hyphen. The final "con-" is continued on the next page as "tractum", which is the catchword. Where the text is set in italic, it is marked as such; roman words inside it (e.g. the reference "Buxtorfii") are not separately marked because they could not be told apart with certainty.
